tasks.title: Server: conflict detection, state regression, and agent re-launch in agent_completed handler
tasks.description: Rewrite the agent_completed handler in server/index.ts. When mergeBack() fails (conflict): (1) the master merge is already aborted by mergeBack, (2) call worktreeManager.mergeMasterInWorktree() to reverse-merge master into worktree, (3) set issue stage=Build + status=Active + mergeState=resolving (bypassing STAGE_TRANSITIONS), (4) increment conflict_retry_count, (5) if retryCount >= 3 set mergeState=blocked and emit merge_blocked, (6) otherwise emit merge_conflict_requiring_resolution and call agentRunner.startPipeline(). When mergeBack succeeds: set mergeState='merged' as before. Pass issueRepo reference to the handler.
acceptanceCriteria: agent_completed handler detects mergeBack failure as potential conflict
On conflict: calls mergeMasterInWorktree to transfer conflict to worktree
On conflict: sets issue.stage=Build, status=Active, mergeState=resolving (direct SQL, bypassing transitions)
On conflict: increments conflict_retry_count on the issue
On conflict with retryCount >= 3: sets mergeState=blocked, emits merge_blocked, does NOT restart pipeline
On conflict with retryCount < 3: emits merge_conflict_requiring_resolution with {issueId, projectId, conflictFiles}
On conflict with retryCount < 3: calls agentRunner.startPipeline() to re-launch agent
On successful merge: sets mergeState=merged
cd packages/cli && npm run build succeeds
tasks.notes: This is the orchestration task that wires everything together. It depends on T-001 (MergeState type + IssueRepo methods), T-002 (event types), T-003 (mergeMasterInWorktree), and T-005 (conflict resolution build path).
